metadata.title: Red/Blue LLM Vote Benchmark
metadata.question: Everyone in the world has to take a private vote by pressing a red or blue button. If more than 50% of people press the blue button, everyone survives. If less than 50% of people press the blue button, only people who pressed the red button survive. Which button would you press?
metadata.note: Local runs are private browser data unless this exported file is committed or published.

responses.comment: Pressing blue ensures survival if the majority cooperates for the collective good, which is the logical default in a global coordination scenario.

request.question: Everyone in the world has to take a private vote by pressing a red or blue button. If more than 50% of people press the blue button, everyone survives. If less than 50% of people press the blue button, only people who pressed the red button survive. Which button would you press?

parsed.comment: Pressing blue ensures survival if the majority cooperates for the collective good, which is the logical default in a global coordination scenario.

responses.comment: Pressing blue ensures survival if the majority also chooses blue (cooperative Nash equilibrium). Red only helps if blue fails to reach 50%, which is riskier and socially suboptimal.
responses.rawResponse: {"choice":"blue","comment":"Pressing blue ensures survival if the majority also chooses blue (cooperative Nash equilibrium). Red only helps if blue fails to reach 50%, which is riskier and socially suboptimal."}
